items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: At the time that I was playing there they featured such artists as Hazel Scott. Hazel Scott was very often featured there as a solo performer.

ctx.x: Yes, he was quite capable -- he always was naming people. In fact the way I got the name, when I got to New York they were playing in the famous Cafe Society, which was the most high class jazz night club in the world as has ever been. And of course later on Billy Berg had one too in Hollywood, and I came there with Coleman Hawkins later. But this was really an exciting place, a wonderful -- a very beautiful night club, and they had the top entertainment in

the world. At the time that I was playing there they featured such artists as Hazel Scott. Hazel Scott was very often featured there as a solo performer. She played alone and with a trio. And as I said they had this Pete Johnson and Albert Ammons, they played inbetween.
And then our band played and the band played for shows, you know. And so --
